name: Cheaters
source:
In an attempt to make their weekend interesting, Cindy and Maika decided to do a ritual on an abandoned house in the middle of a small town (pretty common eh?) but something went terribly wrong, and know they must know why, and survive.

Are you ready to uncover the truth? Do you think you can save ALL of the characters?

[From [url=https://venado-artificial.itch.io/cheaters]Itch.io[/url]]
